integrity_notes: The algebraic sign implications and all six symbolic numerator identities are given explicitly; a standalone standard-library verifier reproduces the identities and an exact counterexample. Publication priority is subject to specialist literature verification; the 1998 weighted-tree paper was compared through its abstract and an accessible 2026 full-text exposition, rather than its own full text.
scientific_limitations: Only the completed two-stage Gauss–Legendre end-step on a four-vertex weighted star, not its internal stages or arbitrary stars.
Requires real strictly positive undirected edge conductances and exact arithmetic; no accuracy superiority or floating-point claim.
The reciprocal-resistance M-matrix cone is established in prior group-inverse literature; the added conclusion is all-timestep rational-method positivity.
title: Exact fourth-order Gauss–Legendre positivity on the weighted three-leaf star
